ticker. Must be valid on NYSE/NASDAQ. Returns latest
trade price in USD. Use for current-price questions only
-- does not return other stock or company info."

POOR: "Gets the stock price for a ticker."
caption: Both are valid JSON Schema. Only one tells the model what to do.

caption: Four questions, every schema, before it ships.
